stdout:
Add a live chat moderator. Use this tool to add a moderator to a live chat.

Usage:
  yutu liveChatModerator insert [flags]

Examples:
# Add a moderator to a live chat
yutu liveChatModerator insert --liveChatId abc123 --moderatorChannelId UC_xyz

Flags:
  -h, --help                        help for insert
  -l, --liveChatId string           ID of the live chat
  -m, --moderatorChannelId string   Channel ID of the moderator
  -o, --output string               json|yaml|silent
  -p, --parts strings               Parts to include (default [snippet])
      --yes                         Confirm the operation
